name: tuichess 3D
subtitle: Chess on a 3D board
promotionalText: Play the tuichess engine on a wooden 3D board: ten levels, from first games to a real fight.
description:
tuichess 3D is chess on a 3D board, against the tuichess engine.

Pick your color and one of ten engine levels, from relaxed first games to a strong opponent, and play on a wooden board with animated pieces.

• Ten engine levels, each with a note on how it plays
• Tap a piece to see where it can go; drag to turn the board, pinch to zoom
• Take back a move, flip the board, resign or start over from the pause menu
• Your game is saved, so you can continue where you left off
• Settings for move hints, last-move marks, shadows and animation speed
• Works offline. No ads, no accounts, no tracking

For iPhone and iPad.

The engine is the one from tuichess, the chess game for your terminal and your AI coding agent: tuichess.dev
reviewNotes:
tuichess 3D is a single-player chess game against a built-in chess engine. There is no login, no account, no network use, no in-app purchase and no user-generated content.

1. SCREEN RECORDING
A screen recording from a physical iPhone running the latest iOS is attached (App Review Information > Attachment). It starts with launching the app and shows a new game, moves against the engine, the camera controls, the pause menu and the settings.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
tuichess 3D lets people play standard chess against the computer on a 3D board. It is for anyone who wants a chess opponent on their iPhone or iPad, from beginners to experienced players: there are ten engine levels, from relaxed first games to a strong opponent. It works offline, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

3. HOW TO USE IT
No setup, login or sample files are needed.
- Launch the app and tap New game.
- Choose your color and an engine level, then tap Start game.
- Tap one of your pieces, then one of the marked squares to move. The engine replies.
- Drag to turn the camera, pinch to zoom.
- Undo and Flip are at the top right. Menu (top right) pauses the game: take back a move, start a new game, change settings, or resign.
- The game in progress is saved: Continue game on the title screen resumes it.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
None. The chess engine is part of the app and runs on the device. The app makes no network requests and uses no data providers, authentication, payment, analytics, advertising or AI services.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works the same in every region.

6. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. The app is not in a regulated industry and contains no protected third-party material: the chess engine, the board and the piece models are our own work (skelpo GmbH).
